A hidden restaurant in Da Nang
Mar 2024 • Family
I saw it on YouTube and really wanted to go there, but there wasn't much information, so I thought about it and went before returning home on an early morning flight.
I was dubious because the Grab taxi driver said it wasn't fresh and tasty, but I was able to see fresh seafood in the aquarium and I was grateful that the beautiful owner and friendly staff responded to me. We ordered raw shrimp sashimi, and when I took a bite, I was surprised that the shrimp were alive.
That’s how fresh it is~
Feeling uncomfortable? I really wanted to try it, but I was disappointed that I couldn't because the ingredients were out of stock.
We were the only Korean customers, so it was nice to be able to feel the atmosphere of a Vietnamese restaurant.
The chef came out and asked if the food was good, and the staff were all very friendly, so it was nice.
If you come to Da Nang, be sure to stop by. Personally, I liked it much better than Tem***.
I had more good memories until the end in Da Nang~♡
